source.section: Other Items · Three Months Ended June 30, 2026
source.quote: The Company repurchased approximately 4.5 million shares of stock for $750 million in the second quarter of 2026.

source.section: Other Items · Q3 2026 dividend declared (not the Q2 paid rate)
source.quote: On July 8, the Board of Directors increased the quarterly dividend by 10% to $0.990 per share, with the third quarter dividend payable on August 14, 2026.
